# Danh mục module của zoo (DLNet 0.20.0)

85 module, 11 decoder phân đoạn (unet, unetpp, fpn, deeplabv3, deeplabv3plus, pspnet, linknet, upernet, segformer, fcn, deconv). Nguồn và kết quả đối chiếu với mã gốc: [THIRD_PARTY.md](../THIRD_PARTY.md). Kiểu tensor và combinator: [architecture.md](architecture.md#kho-module-zoo).

| op | in kinds | out | tags | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `act` | vec,seq,ser,map,vol | same | act | torch.nn; modular_deep_learning (escort) |
| `attn_seq` | seq | same | attn | prescient-design/cortex self-attention with pre-norm and residual inside |
| `basic_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | rasbt/deeplearning-models BasicBlock; pytorch/vision resnet |
| `bottleneck` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | rasbt/deeplearning-models Bottleneck; pytorch/vision resnet (ResNeXt: groups, Wide: base_width) |
| `cbam` | map | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.CbamModule |
| `center_spectrum` | map | ser | adapt,stem | DLNet HSI: the spectrum of the centre pixel as a series (1, bands) |
| `cls_token` | seq | same | embed | ViT / BERT class token |
| `conv1d_resid` | ser | same | block | prescient-design/cortex Conv1dResidBlock: norm-act-conv-norm-act-conv + residual (out = 0 keeps channels) |
| `conv_bn_act` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down,stem | pytorch/vision Conv2dNormActivation; rasbt/deeplearning-models (conv layers) |
| `convmixer_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | huggingface/pytorch-image-models models.convmixer (ConvMixer block) |
| `convnext_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | pytorch/vision convnext.CNBlock (shape preserving, residual inside) |
| `coord_attn` | map | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.CoordAttn |
| `cross_net` | vec | same | block,interaction | DCN (arXiv:1708.05123), from memory |
| `dense_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | rasbt/deeplearning-models _DenseBlock/_DenseLayer; Huang et al., arXiv:1608.06993 |
| `dropout` | vec,seq,ser,map,vol | same | reg | torch.nn |
| `dw_sep` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | MobileNet (Howard et al., arXiv:1704.04861), from memory |
| `eca` | ser,map,vol | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.EcaModule (k = 0: adaptive kernel) |
| `embed_fields` | ids | seq | stem | ylongqi/openrec LatentFactor (tf2), one table per id field |
| `feature_tokens` | vec | seq | adapt,stem | FT-Transformer (Gorishniy et al., arXiv:2106.11959): one token per feature, from memory |
| `ffn` | vec,seq | same | block | Transformer feed-forward (cortex MLP uses ratio 4); wrap in res for a residual |
| `fire` | ser,map,vol | same | block | pytorch/vision squeezenet.Fire |
| `flatten` | seq,ser,map,vol,graph | vec | adapt | torch.nn |
| `fm_interaction` | vec | same | block,interaction | ylongqi/openrec SecondOrderFeatureInteraction (tf2) ported to PyTorch |
| `fused_mbconv` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | pytorch/vision efficientnet.FusedMBConv |
| `gap` | ser,map,vol | vec | adapt | torch.nn |
| `gat` | graph | same | block | GAT (Velickovic et al., arXiv:1710.10903), from memory; dense attention |
| `gc_block` | map | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.GlobalContext (GCNet) |
| `gcn` | graph | same | block | GCN (Kipf & Welling, arXiv:1609.02907), from memory |
| `ghost_bottleneck` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | huggingface/pytorch-image-models models.ghostnet.GhostBottleneck |
| `gin` | graph | same | block | GIN (Xu et al., arXiv:1810.00826), from memory |
| `glu` | vec,seq | same | block | Gated linear unit (Dauphin et al., arXiv:1612.08083), from memory |
| `gmf` | seq | vec | adapt | Generalised matrix factorisation (He et al., arXiv:1708.05031; ylongqi/openrec gmf.py): product of the first two field embeddings |
| `graph_readout` | graph | vec | adapt | graph pooling over nodes |
| `grid_graph_avg` | map | same | block | rasbt/deeplearning-models gnn-basic-1: neighbour averaging with the normalised Gaussian grid adjacency |
| `grid_spectral_conv` | map | same | block | rasbt/deeplearning-models gnn-basic-graph-spectral-1 (eigh of the dense Laplacian instead of scipy eigsh; trained filters) |
| `grn` | ser,map,vol | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.GlobalResponseNorm (channels-first form) |
| `inception` | ser,map,vol | same | block | pytorch/vision googlenet.Inception |
| `lenet_stage` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | rasbt/deeplearning-models LeNet5 feature stage: conv, tanh, 2x pooling |

| `mlp` | vec,seq | same | block | rasbt/deeplearning-models MLP; ylongqi/openrec MLP; cortex MLP |
| `nin_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | rasbt/deeplearning-models NiN (Lin et al., arXiv:1312.4400): conv, then two 1x1 convs |
| `norm` | vec,seq,ser,map,vol | same | norm | torch.nn; rasbt/deeplearning-models (FRN) |
| `pair_dots` | seq | vec | adapt,interaction | ylongqi/openrec SecondOrderFeatureInteraction (tf2) ported to PyTorch |
| `patch_merge` | map | same | down | pytorch/vision swin_transformer.PatchMerging |
| `patchify` | map,ser | seq | adapt,stem | ViT (arXiv:2010.11929) patch embedding, from memory |
| `pool` | ser,map,vol | same | down | torch.nn |
| `pool_flatten` | ser,map,vol | vec | adapt | torch.nn (CNN heads of the earlier families) |
| `poolformer_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | huggingface/pytorch-image-models models.metaformer (PoolFormer v1 block) |
| `pos` | seq | same | embed | prescient-design/cortex SinePosEncoder; ViT |
| `preact_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | ResNet v2 (arXiv:1603.05027), from memory |
| `regnet_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | pytorch/vision regnet.ResBottleneckBlock |
| `repvgg_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | huggingface/pytorch-image-models models.byobnet.RepVggBlock |
| `res2net_block` | map | same | block,down | huggingface/pytorch-image-models models.res2net.Bottle2neck |

| `sage` | graph | same | block | GraphSAGE mean aggregator (arXiv:1706.02216), from memory |
| `scse` | map | same | attn | qubvel-org/segmentation_models_pytorch base.modules.SCSEModule (Roy et al., arXiv:1803.02579) |
| `se` | ser,map,vol | same | attn | pytorch/vision SqueezeExcitation; Hu et al. |
| `segres_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block | Project-MONAI/MONAI networks.blocks.segresnet_block.ResBlock |
| `self_attn` | ser,map,vol | same | attn | torch.nn.MultiheadAttention over spatial tokens |
| `seq_pool` | seq | vec | adapt | prescient-design/cortex MeanPooling / WeightedMeanPooling (padding mask dropped) |
| `seq_to_ser` | seq | ser | adapt | DLNet |
| `shuffle_unit` | map | same | block,down | pytorch/vision shufflenetv2.InvertedResidual (out is ignored when s=1) |
| `sk_conv` | map | same | block,down | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.SelectiveKernel (SKNet) |
| `split_attn` | map | same | block,down | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.SplitAttn (ResNeSt) |

| `to_vol` | map | vol | adapt,stem | DLNet HSI: (bands, H, W) -> (1, bands, H, W), the spectrum becomes the depth axis |
